catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.intro: Everything you sell. Edits to prices and stock apply straight away.
catalog.new.title: Add product
catalog.edit.title: Edit product
catalog.empty.title: No products yet
catalog.empty.body: Add your first product, or import many at once from a CSV file.
catalog.form.moderationHint: Changes to text and photos go live straight away. Ciuna reviews them afterwards and may ask you to fix them.
catalog.form.publishLater: You can publish once Ciuna approves your business.
catalog.lang.defaultHint: Default language. This is shown when a customer's language isn't filled in.
catalog.lang.otherHint: Optional. Leave blank to show your default language.
catalog.field.title: Name
catalog.field.shortHint: Shown in lists. Up to 300 characters.
catalog.field.salePriceHint: Optional. Must be lower than the price.
catalog.field.soldOutHint: Customers can't order it until you switch this off.
catalog.photos.hint: The first photo is the main one. Add up to 8 more.
catalog.mode.deliveryHint: You deliver this to the customer.
catalog.mode.pickupHint: The customer collects it from your pickup location.
catalog.archive.title: Archive this product?
catalog.archive.body: It will disappear from the store. Past orders keep their details, and you can still find it under Archived.
catalog.fulfilment.title: Delivery and pickup
catalog.fulfilment.intro: Set where customers collect orders and which areas you deliver to. You need delivery zones to publish delivery products, and pickup details to publish pickup products.
catalog.fulfilment.pickupHint: Customers see this when they choose pickup.
catalog.fulfilment.hoursHint: For example: Mon to Sat, 9:00 to 20:00
catalog.fulfilment.zonesHint: Customers can order delivery only in the zones you list.
catalog.fulfilment.pickupMissing: Add your pickup address to publish pickup products.
catalog.fulfilment.zonesMissing: Add at least one active delivery zone to publish delivery products.
catalog.import.title: Import products
catalog.import.intro: Add up to 200 products from a CSV file. They are created as drafts so you can check them first.
catalog.import.step1Hint: Fill in one product per row. Up to {max} rows. Use a period or comma for decimals.
catalog.import.badFile: We couldn't read that file. Use the template and check the title and list_price columns.
catalog.import.summary: {file}: {valid} ready, {invalid} with problems. Only ready rows are imported.
catalog.import.tooMany: Only the first {max} of {total} rows are used.
catalog.import.lineUnknown: Categories are checked when each product is created.
catalog.import.draftNote: Created products are drafts. Open each one to add photos, then publish.
errors.TITLE_REQUIRED: Enter a name with at least 2 characters.
errors.SALE_PRICE_TOO_HIGH: The sale price must be lower than the price.
errors.INVALID_STOCK: Enter a whole number of 0 or more.
errors.CATEGORY_OUTSIDE_LINE: That category isn't available for your store.
errors.GALLERY_INVALID: Use up to 8 photos with https links.
errors.LISTING_REJECTED: This listing was rejected. Edit the text or photos to submit it again.
errors.VENDOR_UNAVAILABLE: Your store isn't available to customers right now.
errors.PICKUP_CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED: Add your pickup address before publishing pickup products.
errors.DELIVERY_ZONE_REQUIRED: Add a delivery zone before publishing delivery products.
errors.PAYMENT_METHOD_REQUIRED: Add a payment method before publishing.
errors.VENDOR_REQUIRED: Set up your store before adding products.
errors.TOO_MANY_ZONES: You can add up to 200 zones.
errors.ZONE_INVALID: Enter a city and a district for every zone.
errors.ZONE_FEE_INVALID: Enter a delivery fee of 0 or more.
errors.ZONE_CURRENCY_INVALID: Choose a supported currency for the zone.
errors.ZONE_DUPLICATE: Each city and district can be listed only once.
